enforcement: the launcher loads this artifact and refuses to create a pod whose priced hard threshold exceeds hard_cap_usd or per_launch_hard_usd, refuses a stage not in authorized_stages, refuses a harness that does not digest to the authorized value, and has no code path to any experiment after Phase A
granted_by: Maintainer decision 2026-10-01, on independent review of review/c3-operator-batching@a87049cc, which established that no maintainer or scientific decision blocks execution. A3 is authorized as ONE complete end-to-end experiment -- initialization, recovery training, evaluation, aggregation, closeout -- rather than as a step-1/step-2 split needing intermediate approvals. Ordinary engineering failures inside this envelope are to be diagnosed, repaired and retried autonomously.
scope: ONE experiment end to end: replay the frozen parent eea90c91346a under its digest gate, verify A-bsz1 rebuilds the incumbent 53e30566c5f7, collect interleaved A-bsz1/A-bsz3 diagnostics, then train THREE A-bsz3 recovery probes at the three frozen C3 seeds and evaluate each once on c1_confirmation_v1. A differing A-bsz3 artifact digest is a FINDING and does not stop the chain. No search, no ranking, no arm elimination, no fourth seed, no retraining of attempt75's controls, no on-pod decision, and no authorization to start the FFN experiment, D1/D2/D3 or Stage-0 v2.
